package appsinterface

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/z-chenhao/assistant/internal/plugin/appsinterface/contract"
	"github.com/z-chenhao/assistant/pkg/rsiplugin"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
)

// Only its own sealed resource is readable here. The isolated process receives
// no actual card, private State, caller path, resource authority or effects.
func compileCardView(ctx context.Context, call rsiplugin.Call) (rsiplugin.Result, error) {
	var input struct{}
	if err := rsiplugin.Decode(call.Input, &input); err != nil {
		return rsiplugin.Result{}, err
	}
	executable, err := os.Executable()
	if err != nil {
		return rsiplugin.Result{}, err
	}
	file, err := os.Open(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(executable), contract.CardViewFile))
	if err != nil {
		return rsiplugin.Result{}, err
	}
	defer file.Close()
	raw, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, 4097))
	if err != nil {
		return rsiplugin.Result{}, err
	}
	if len(raw) > 4096 {
		return rsiplugin.Result{}, fmt.Errorf("card resource exceeds limit")
	}
	var source contract.CardSource
	if err = rsiplugin.Decode(raw, &source); err != nil {
		return rsiplugin.Result{}, err
	}
	return rsiplugin.JSONResult(ctx, contract.CardView{Resource: contract.CardViewResource, Digest: rsiplugin.FileDigest(raw), Program: source.Program})
}
